features.name: any_counter_comment_has_url
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a URL or hyperlink?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings. If missing/malformed, return null. If the list is empty, return 0. Return 1 if any comment matches regex r'(https?://|www\.)\S+' or markdown link r'\[[^\]]+\]\([^)]+\)' (case-insensitive); else 0. Mechanical match, no semantic filtering.

h0: any_counter_comment_has_url has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Rows with a counter-argument containing a URL/hyperlink have a higher probability of delta.
note: Row-level test: comments lack per-comment outcomes, so we cannot tell which comment won the delta; this tests whether a row has any URL-bearing counter-argument, not that the specific URL comment earned the delta. Raw text matching may include URLs in delta-award or other post-outcome text (e.g., bot messages); this contamination is not filtered. Comment timing is unknown. Association only; OLS on binary outcome is a linear probability model.
